state.offline: Offline · your draft stays here and is sent when you are back online
state.checking: Checking the reply before it is shown
state.still_working: A reply is taking longer than usual · you can keep reading and asking
state.unavailable: Companion service unavailable · your question is saved
job.configurationMissing: Waiting for service configuration · your message is saved
job.couldNotAnswer: Reply not shown · it did not pass the checks, so nothing of it was kept · you can ask your question again
job.checking: Reply written · checking it before it is shown
job.unavailable: Reply unavailable · it could not be prepared · you can ask your question again
job.stalled: Reply unavailable · the AI service didn't answer in time · you can ask your question again
job.stillWorking: Taking longer than usual · your question is saved
job.cancelled: Cancelled before it was sent · nothing was used · your message is saved
state.replying: Writing a reply · it is checked before it is kept
job.writing: Sent · a reply is being written
job.cancelledSent: Stopped after it was sent · nothing of the reply was kept · what the call used until then counts toward this course's AI use
job.pausedWorkspace: Help is paused · this course's AI budget is used up, so the companion can't answer for now. Course staff have been told. Your question is saved; you can ask it again when help is back.
job.pausedLearner: Help is paused · you've used the AI help set aside for you in this course, so the companion can't answer for now. Course staff have been told. Your question is saved; you can ask it again when help is back.
job.pausedToday: Help is paused for today · you've used today's AI help in this course. Course staff have been told. Your question is saved; you can ask it again tomorrow.
job.pausedLessonToday: Help is paused for today · you've used today's AI help for this lesson. Course staff have been told. Your question is saved; you can ask it again tomorrow.
state.paused: Help is paused · your question is saved
job.stalledPartWay: Reply unavailable · the AI service stopped part way through, so nothing of the reply was kept · you can ask your question again
job.refused: Not sent · this question could not be passed on to the AI service · nothing was used · you can ask it again
job.withheld: Reply withheld · it gave away the answer to one of the course's checks · a hint without the answer follows
job.interrupted: The reply stopped part way through · nothing of it was kept
job.notShown: Reply not shown · it did not pass the checks, so nothing of it was kept
job.withdrawn: Reply not shown · nothing of it was kept
job.unverified: Reply not shown · it could not be checked against the course's checks, so it was not kept · a hint without the answer follows
